newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Language barrier foils Dutch stick-up attempt.
newsitem.headline: Language barrier foils Dutch stick-up attempt.

text.p: A masked gunman who tried to hold up an Amsterdam snack bar was forced to flee empty-handed after a foreign employee was unable to understand his demand for money, police said on Thursday.
"The only staff member present at the time barely spoke Dutch and the robber was apparently unable to make it clear to him that he wanted money," a spokesman said.
"Language barriers sometimes have their advantages," he added. The case is under investigation.
